It is a fact that education plays a vital role in the survival and success of individuals as well as nations. In this modern age, no nation can progress without education. We must produce graduates of the highest intellectual caliber, and thus find a respectable place amongst the developed nations of the world. Our main source of inspiration: Islam, guide us towards the pursuit of knowledge and education. We thus must follow the golden principles of Islam and excel in both religious and modern education.
The S.R.H campus Pabbi, Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan is the newly established campus. It is a source of great satisfaction that, by the grace of Almighty Allah, Management Science Department of the University Campus has progressed by gigantic leaps and has gained a coveted position in a very short period and enjoying the trust and confidence of students and parents.
We have put all our efforts together in providing a congenial environment to the students for grooming them into capable professionals. The faculty, the administration and the management are committed to attain these goals.
I wish you all the best for achieving your goals. May Allah bless us with Divine Guidance to carry out this noble mission, Ameen!
